scope: Structural proof from emitted RTL, separate from pixel-checked test configurations; no speedup or desktop qualification claim

initial_broad_regression.failure: Reset blocked internal shader launches needed by the admitted render; draw could not drain. Fixed by allowing internal work until graphicsDrained, while the command router blocks new renders.

validation.interpretation: Test sets overlap; do not add their counts. Pixel-checked shared renderer uses one four-lane/two-warp CU and real TexSampleUnit/TextureUnit, instruction/texture/staging translation and faults, ASID/VPN changes, reset and recovery, CPU-updated staging, and guest shader instruction streams. The FPU-enabled emitted model is structural evidence; shared scalar FP desktop execution is not qualified by these pixel tests.

limits: One graphics task at a time in the compatibility adapter; this is shared execution, not parallel single-draw scaling yet.
The initial opt-in ABI uses four lanes and two warps. The emitter rejects an unqualified 16-lane shared graphics configuration.
No GPU-cycle, simulation-throughput or Debian-startup speedup claimed for this milestone.
